name: api-keys
title: Prefixed API keys with HMAC storage, optional KV verify cache and owner routes
description: Keys like ak_live_<id8>_<secret43>: the secret is shown once and stored only as an HMAC with a pepper. Verification reads an optional KV cache, then D1, with a constant-time compare. Revocation busts the cache. Includes a requireApiKey middleware, owner-scoped create/list/rename/revoke routes, a 50-key cap and optional scope labels. Without a KV binding there is simply no cache.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: appSlug
params.description: Short name used for resources (D1 name in the config patch).

params.name: keyPrefix
params.description: Key prefix; makes keys greppable and secret-scannable (for example xk_live_).

params.name: tablePrefix
params.description: Prefix for the block's table; set when the project already has an api_keys table.

params.name: routePrefix
params.description: Mount point for the owner routes.

params.name: cacheTtlS
params.description: Seconds a verified key stays in KV (Cloudflare KV minimum is 60); also the longest a revoke can take to reach another colo.

secrets.name: KEY_PEPPER
secrets.description: 16+ random chars; HMAC pepper for key hashes. Changing it invalidates every key.

bindings.name: KEY_CACHE
bindings.note: Optional verify cache. Without it every call reads D1; nothing else changes.

routes.description: List the signed-in owner's keys (never the hash).
Create a key; the full key is in this response only.

agent.summary: Adds prefixed API keys to a Hono Worker: one table, a requireApiKey middleware and owner-scoped create/list/rename/revoke routes. Keys are stored as HMAC with a pepper secret. A KV binding adds a verify cache; without it every call reads D1. Needs a D1 binding and the KEY_PEPPER secret.
when_to_use: Programs or CLIs call the API with a long-lived key a person can create and revoke.
You want keys that secret scanners can recognise by prefix.
when_not_to_use: You need OAuth tokens or per-key spend caps.
Revocation must take effect everywhere in under a second: skip KEY_CACHE and read D1 only, or add a Durable Object revoked set.

adapt.title: Set KEY_PEPPER
adapt.do: Add KEY_PEPPER=<16+ random chars> to .dev.vars; in production use wrangler secret put KEY_PEPPER.
adapt.check: The test suite passes; creating a key works.

adapt.title: Protect API routes with requireApiKey
adapt.check: GET /v1/... without a key returns 401; with a key, c.get('apiKey').owner_id is set.

adapt.title: Mount the owner routes behind your own sign-in
adapt.do: import { apiKeyRoutes } from './lib/api-keys/routes'; app.route('{{kit.routePrefix}}', apiKeyRoutes((c) => c.get('member')?.id ?? null));
adapt.check: POST {{kit.routePrefix}} without sign-in returns 401; signed in returns 201 with the key.

adapt.title: Create the KV namespace, or drop the cache
adapt.do: wrangler kv namespace create KEY_CACHE and put its id in wrangler.jsonc; or delete the kv_namespaces entry to run without a cache.
adapt.check: With the entry removed, authentication still works and reads D1 each time.

agent.author_notes: A revoked key can still pass at other colos for up to cacheTtlS seconds when KEY_CACHE is bound. Pair with d1-rate-limit to limit by key id.
